hypotheses.R0_pair_clustered_advantage_is_material: After aggregating contexts within lexical pair, median correct-minus-wrong advantage is at least 0.03 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R1_most_pairs_prefer_correct_family: At least 65% of lexical pairs have positive correct-family advantage in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R2_correct_bank_is_often_top1: The correct family bank has the largest median effect for at least half of lexical pairs in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R3_family_mapping_beats_permutation: The true pair-to-family mapping exceeds 99% of 5,000 size-preserving family-label permutations in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R4_bootstrap_interval_excludes_zero: The pair-bootstrap 95% interval for median family advantage excludes zero in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.R5_pair_difficulty_is_cross_corpus_stabl: FineWeb and TinyStories pair advantages have Spearman correlation at least 0.30 at both layers.
hypotheses.R6_result_is_not_one_family: At least four of five families have positive median pair-level advantage on both corpora at each layer.
hypotheses.R7_strict_core_is_pairwise_positive: At least 65% of pairs have positive strict recurrent-core fidelity in every layer and corpus.
